# Engine tests that AnyTogether CI (.github/workflows/anytogether-ci.yml) leaves out of ctest.
#
# Every line: <platforms> <test name, a regular expression for the whole name> <reason>
#   platforms: all, or a comma list of linux, windows, macos
# Only add a test here when it fails on main too (a known, tracked failure) or when it depends on the
# runner rather than the code (timing under load, real network, a GPU the runner lacks). A test that
# a pull request breaks is a regression: fix it, do not list it. Remove a line once its test passes.
# Every engine job also gives a failing test two more tries (ctest --repeat until-pass:3), for the
# timing tests that miss their marks on a shared runner now and then; one that keeps failing fails.

# Known failures of the fork on every host (they fail on main and on the developers' Macs too).
all     net_dontwait_.*                 Non-blocking socket timing; fails since the eighth upstream merge.
all     guest_sce_net                   Needs network interfaces the way the console reports them.
all     guest_update_env(_pending_[0-9]_[0-9])?  feupdateenv does not trap an enabled pending exception on the host.
all     guest_floating_point            x87/denormal modes differ from the console (Rosetta and host libm).
all     guest_math                      _FSinh and friends round differently on the host libm.
all     guest_math_exact                Bit-exact libm results the host libm does not give.
all     agc_spirv_subvector_loop_begin  s_subvector_loop_begin's lowering has no exec == 0 branch; fails on main on Linux, Windows and macOS.
all     agc_layer_input                 "a Layer input on a device with geometry shaders must declare Geometry"; fails on main on every host.
all     public_headers(_compile_[0-9]+)?  Our local guest declarations not yet moved to headers (follow-up); the compile batches need its manifest.

# Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 runner, lavapipe from Mesa 25).
linux   guest_sysmodule(_maps_scan)?    Aborts on Linux on main (passes on macOS); needs a look.
linux   agc_driver_sampled_cache_budget(_without_storage_image_multisample)?  The runner's lavapipe heap gives a sampled texture budget below the 2 GiB floor the test asks for.
linux   agc_driver                      Fails on main on lavapipe ("a small copy whose source the GPU still stores into was not recorded on the GPU"); needs a look.
linux   agc_driver_optimize_on_fiber    Needs SPIRV-Tools, which the fork's builds leave off (it would only report a skip). With SPIRV-Tools on, agc_spirv_optimizer* and agc_driver_pixel_sample_iteration fail on main too.
linux   agc_driver_image_sample_lod_clamp_shader_lane  Upstream test (#12980, its Linux job did not run), fails on lavapipe on upstream's own tree too: a filtered image_sample_lz through an S# that holds the LOD at 0 reads one mip level off. #15333 widened one check, the trilinear case still fails.
linux   agc_driver_image_gather_lod  New upstream lavapipe test; level 1 of a gather reads 0 here. Upstream's runner passes it on Mesa 26.0.8 (run 44716515864), this runner has Ubuntu 24.04's Mesa 25.2.8; the shader code is upstream's.
linux   agc_driver_image_table_packed_guards  New upstream lavapipe test ("unrecoverable packed table format was not poisoned"); passes on upstream's Mesa 26.0.8 runner (run 44716515864), fails on this runner's Mesa 25.2.8; the materializer and table code are upstream's.
linux   guest_thermal_sensors       Reads the runner's real hwmon and SoC sensors: 0.02 s on the AMD EPYC runners (runs 44721839889, 44756068076 attempt 2), over 20 s on all three tries on the Intel Xeon 6975P ones (44756068076 attempt 1, 44774113524). The sensor code and the test are upstream's unchanged; needs a look at which host read stalls there.
linux   agc_performance_overlay     Upstream's 51d701f159 reads the CPU temperature from the runner's real /sys/class sensors on each once-a-second overlay sample, the read guest_thermal_sensors stalls on above; the test's cost report takes about 870 samples. On the Intel Xeon 6975P-C runner it timed out at 30 s on all three tries (run 45187691989), where main passes it in 2.2 s (run 45067949275) and Windows passes it on the same tree; needs a look (#175).
linux   agc_driver_dma_buf_chunk_window  New upstream test (43f5c91381) that needs /dev/udmabuf, which this runner does not give the job: it skips with "/dev/udmabuf is not accessible", a reason tools/check_skips.py does not accept (run 45259024550). Upstream's linux runner opens it and passes (job 137886759061 of boykopovar/AnyPS5). Off until the job can open /dev/udmabuf (#175).
linux   agc_driver_image_d16_load  New upstream lavapipe test (a86c5cd26d): a D16 image_load of the 16_FLOAT signaling NaN 0x7c01 reads 0x7e01, lavapipe quiets it. Fails the same on upstream's own tree a8654598c5 with no fork code on this runner's Mesa 25.2.8 (run 46070041249, job 140744524446); upstream's Linux job did not run it (#22750 skipped it, main's runs since were cancelled). Needs a look (#192).
linux   agc_driver_image_filter_mode_three  New upstream lavapipe test (fbe1357755): its filter mode 1 draw needs min/max filtering of R8G8B8A8_UNORM (format 37), which Mesa 25.2.8's lavapipe does not report. Fails the same on upstream's own tree a8654598c5 (run 46070041249, job 140744524446); upstream's Linux job did not run it (#22665 skipped it). Needs a look (#192).

# Windows: real failures on main, to fix (WinLibs GCC 15.2, as the owner's Windows builds).
windows prx_thread_local_destructors    libkernel (dl*_nid_postfix, LoadFailure) and AgcDriver (LockStats) register thread_local destructors, which run after emulated TLS is freed on Windows; they belong in HostThreadLocal.
windows agc_frame_generation            The test executable does not start on Windows (0xc0000135: a DLL it links is not found).

# Timing tests: they measure wall-clock sleeps, which a shared runner cannot keep.
all     precise_wait                    Spin/sleep deadline test; upstream's own release job leaves it out too.

# macOS: x86-64 under Rosetta in a virtual machine, and no MoltenVK on the runner.
macos   macos_fixtures                  Its argv fixture ends in int3, which stays exiting in the kernel under Rosetta.
macos   guest_kernel_fcntl              Flaky under parallel ctest on macOS.
macos   agc_thread_priority_refused_rt  Expects a refused real-time priority request to throw; macOS grants it.
macos   agc_thread_priority_refused_high  Same as above, high priority.
macos   guest_radix64                   Its 8-thread l64a loop makes each digit a GuestCopyOut, whose GuestArena::HostWrite takes the write watch's global lock on macOS: 0.36 s on main, over 20 s since upstream's checked copies (de7b12bdaa); the fault-recovering copy does not change that lock. Needs a look.
macos   guest_icu_recovered_signatures  New upstream test: after udata_close unmaps a mapping, mincore under Rosetta (4 KiB pages on a 16 KiB-page kernel) fails without ENOMEM (DataMemoryClose.cpp:144, which now prints the errno); needs a look.
macos   guest_libc_internal_exception_virtuals  New upstream test: host code catches a guest-thrown std::future_error by type, which macOS's libc++ names NSt3__112future_errorE, a different class from the guest's St12future_error; matching the two names makes the host handler take a guest object as its own (_Unwind_Resume aborts). Needs a look.
macos   guest_libcxx_exception_pointer  New upstream test (f56e21848f): host code catches, as int, an exception the guest runtime rethrows. On macOS the host catch runs libc++abi's personality, which takes the guest runtime's exception class (ANYPC++, Runtime.hpp) as foreign and matches only catch (...); on Linux and Windows the guest runtime is the host's. Fails on all three tries of the merge run 44859973962 ("did not rethrow its guest exception"). Needs a look.
macos   agc_driver_pm4_priority_refused Same as above, for the PM4 queue priority.
macos   agc_shared_write                Cannot inspect mapping lifetimes on macOS.
macos   agc_write_tracking              Known macOS failure (also on the developers' Macs): a block outside the import window reads as written.
macos   agc_submit_progress(_no_timeline)?  Needs a Vulkan device; the runner has no MoltenVK (also fails on the developers' Macs).
macos   agc_driver_pipelined_prefetch   Known macOS failure: the AGC FS table cannot be mapped under Rosetta.
macos   agc_driver_graphics             Known macOS hang: a failed map import is retried and the probe remap deadlocks on the imports mutex.
macos   guest_memory                    Known macOS failure: mprotect of guest memory is refused (deterministic since the eighth merge).
macos   guest_kernel_app_archive_mmap   Known macOS failure: mmap of a file read from app0.zar is not implemented there.
macos   font_face_lifetime(_replace|_churn)?  The test finishes, then its process does not exit within the timeout under Rosetta on the runner.
macos   guest_memory_lifetime           Its exit probe times out under Rosetta on the runner.
macos   guest_ssl_transport_(kernel|net)  On the runner a server certificate passes the initial verify without a loaded CA (its trust store differs); needs a look.
macos   guest_avplayer                  Its EOF stop latency median must stay under 10 ms; on the macOS runner it is 12-14 ms, even on retries.
macos   guest_itimer_short_expiry   Its 2 ms ITIMER_REAL median must stay near 2 ms; on the macOS runner it is 13-17 ms on every retry, on main too (passes on the developers' Macs).
macos   guest_kqueue                    Its timer counts and gaps (GuestKqueue.cpp:1868, 1888, 1895) miss on every retry on the macOS runner since 2026-11-25: on main, on main from before the upstream merge #179 (run 45724103718) and run alone (#181). Passed on 2026-11-24 (run 45374365531). Needs a look (#180).
macos   guest_exception_pointer     New upstream test: the host test throws and catches a C++ exception, then asks the guest runtime's std::current_exception for it. On macOS the host catch is libc++abi's, which the guest runtime does not see ("current_exception inside catch returned wrong pointer", all three tries of run 46072361298), the case of guest_libcxx_exception_pointer above. Needs a look (#192).
macos   guest_icu_unicode_string_hash  New upstream test (ac75555824): uhash_compareCaselessUnicodeString finds "Hello" and "HELLO" different on macOS (UnicodeStringHash.cpp:139, all three tries of run 46072361298); Linux and Windows pass. Needs a look (#192).
macos   guest_avplayer_buffer_wait_accuracy  New upstream timing test: a 33 ms buffer wait has a 130 ms median on the macOS runner under Rosetta, on all three tries of run 46072361298 (as guest_avplayer above). Needs a look on real hardware (#192).
macos   guest_poll                      Aborts on the macOS runner (virtual machine networking); needs a look on real hardware.
macos   guest_socket_pair               Aborts on the macOS runner (virtual machine networking); needs a look on real hardware.

# macOS: upstream tests that came in or changed with the October 27 upstream merge and fail only on macOS.
macos   guest_pthread_create_suspended  Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked.
macos   guest_raise_except(_trap_[0-9])?  Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked (an enabled x87 exception does not trap).
macos   guest_dinkumware_internals      Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked (_Exp subnormal result classification).
macos   agc_performance_overlay_statistics  Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked (the system's commit charge cannot be read).
macos   guest_jxr_stream                Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked (packet mapping outside the guest arena).
macos   guest_posix_spawn               Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked.
macos   net_ipv6only                    Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked (IPV6_V6ONLY errno not mapped).
macos   guest_raw_resolver              Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked (numeric canonical name differs).
macos   guest_dynamic_loader            Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked.
macos   guest_host_standard_error       Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked.
macos   guest_kernel_app_archive_archive  Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked.
macos   guest_job_manager_worker_spin(_scale_[0-9.]+)?  Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked (upstream's new JobManager; about 19.7 s of its 20 s timeout on the runner).
macos   guest_sysmodule(_maps_scan)?    Upstream test, fails on macOS/Rosetta, tracked (aborts now and then, also on retries, since upstream changed it).

# macOS: upstream tests from the November 2 upstream merge that fail the same way on upstream's own tree
# (1348026318, built for x86-64 on a Mac, without any AnyTogether change).
macos   guest_dinkumware_float_bits     Upstream test, aborts the same way on upstream's tree on macOS/Rosetta (x87 and SSE flags).
macos   guest_dinkumware_division       Upstream test, fails the same way on upstream's tree on macOS/Rosetta (case 69: flags 2a, expected 28).
macos   agc_unit_flags_allocation_failure_populated  Upstream test, fails the same way on upstream's tree on macOS ("failed growth changed the existing unit flags").
macos   guest_set_env(_pending_[0-9])?  Upstream test, fails the same way on upstream's tree on macOS/Rosetta: unmasked x87 exceptions are not kept ("independent x87/SSE exception masks restored", "restored pending exception did not trap"), as guest_update_env.
